clips.title: The story
paras: Chef Jessen of Southshore prides himself on preparing the finest cuisine north of Stormwind, but recent unrest has cut off his supply of fresh snapjaw turtle meat. To restore his famous Soothing Turtle Bisque to the tavern menu, he asks culinary-minded travelers to brave the dangerous northern waters near Dalaran and Lake Lordamere.

Southshore remains one of the Alliance's last intact coastal towns in Lordaeron, clinging proudly to civilian life amidst mounting regional strife. Chef Jessen claims that his cooking rivals any tavern north of Stormwind, with patrons supposedly trekking from as far as Darkshire in Duskwood just for a taste of his specialty: Soothing Turtle Bisque. The rich, restorative soup depends entirely on fresh meat from the snapjaw turtles indigenous to the rivers and lakes of the northern mountains.

In calmer years, Jessen gathered turtle meat himself by journeying up past Dalaran to the eastern shores of Lordamere Lake. However, rising tensions, hostile wildlife, the Syndicate, and Forsaken incursions have made foraging outside town lethal for ordinary townsfolk. To keep his pot simmering and his patrons satisfied, the chef relies on armed adventurers willing to harvest meat from the snapjaws lurking along the riverbanks and northern shores.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If there's one thing you'll learn about Southshore it's that we have some of the best cuisine north of Stormwind!

Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks to travel from as far as Darkshire just to enjoy a bowl. Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. I used to head up past Dalaran to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt Snapjaws but it's just too dangerous now. If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the Snapjaws up north and Soothing Spices, I'll whip some up!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any luck finding the ingredients? I'll tell you, this territory isn't the peaceful place it once was. Ah, if only this unrest never occurred...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Everyone will be so pleased: Chef Jessen's Soothing Turtle Bisque is served once again!
